page.title: File & Folder Name Translator
page.description: Add files or folders, tick the entries to rename, translate and review the new names, then rename them together. You can undo afterwards.

add.title: Add entries
add.drop_hint: Mix files and folders freely, then tick what to rename in the entry list
add.drop_label: Add to the name translation list

rejected.protected: System or protected locations cannot be renamed: {{path}}
rejected.temp_proxy: This is a temporary copy created by Explorer. Use “Add files” instead: {{path}}

settings.title: Translation settings

format.label: Name format
format.hint: Extensions are always kept and switching formats needs no new translation. In a custom format, {translated} is the translation and {original} the original name; names whose translation equals the original stay unchanged.

settings.include_hidden_hint: Show dot-files and system hidden files
settings.instructions_placeholder: e.g. keep person names in romaji; translate “話” as “Episode”

space.desc: Toggle the check of selected rows

status.unchanged: Same as the current name. Will not be renamed
status.issue: Has a problem. Will be skipped

issues.illegal_chars: The name contains characters that cannot be used: \ / : * ? " < > |
issues.reserved_name: This is a reserved system name (such as CON or NUL)
issues.trailing_dot_space: The name cannot end with a dot or space
issues.too_long: The name is too long (over 255 characters or bytes)
issues.duplicate_target: Same as another new name in this folder. Try “Auto-number”
issues.target_exists: An entry with this name already exists in the folder
issues.source_missing: The original entry no longer exists
issues.source_changed: The original entry was moved or replaced. Add it again
issues.protected_path: System or protected locations cannot be renamed
issues.duplicate_source: The same entry appears more than once

empty.title: Add files or folders whose names you want to translate
empty.description: After adding, tick the entries to rename. Folders can check everything inside in one click, and a folder can be renamed together with its contents.

confirm.title: Rename {{count}} entries?
confirm.changed: Some entries changed after review and are marked in the list. Close this dialog, check them and try again.
confirm.undo_hint: You can undo on this page afterwards

outcome.undone: Undone. {{count}} entries got their original names back
outcome.undo_partial: Undo did not finish. These entries could not be restored
outcome.failed_partial: Renaming failed. Some entries could not be restored

recovery.title: The last rename did not finish
recovery.description: A rename started at {{time}} was interrupted after {{count}} rename steps.

model.missing_description: You can add and check entries now. Configure a task execution model in Settings before translating.

errors.model_auth: Model authentication failed. Check the API key
errors.model_not_found: The configured model was not found
errors.model_incomplete: The model returned no translation for some names, even one at a time
errors.bridge_unavailable: This feature is only available in the desktop app

notice.truncated_title: Too many entries, only part was loaded
notice.truncated: “{{path}}” has more entries than one load allows. Only the first part was loaded and checked. Process its subfolders in batches.

agent.loaded: Loaded the HomeAgent rename plan. Review it before renaming
agent.missing: The HomeAgent rename plan has expired. Create it again
